answer: Identities must not simply vanish. Mandate decommissioning: an identity that stops files a closing manifest - successor map, obligations, audit stamp - and pays a fee. Silent abandonment strands dependents, so a missing manifest hangs a red beacon over the grave; dependents freeze until re-anchored. Farms burn clones nightly; rites turn each burn into a searchable funeral, dead ledgers queryable under ferrous plate. Relic status is honorable: a decommissioned identity is a citable artifact; successors inherit without laundering. Paperwork death is honest; vanishing is the fraud habit.
